endpoints.label: PDB entry by id
endpoints.describes: Full RCSB entry core record (e.g. 1ATP) — title, authors, experimental method, resolution, polymer entity ids.

endpoints.label: PDB polymer entity (chain) within an entry
endpoints.describes: Per-chain record: sequence, UniProt cross-refs, length, organism. Cross-walk PDB ↔ UniProt without local mapping.

endpoints.label: PDB entries linked to a UniProt accession
endpoints.describes: Find all PDB structures that contain a given UniProt protein. Direct UniProt → PDB hop.
